title: 2023 AMC 10A Problem 1
statement: Cities \(A\) and \(B\) are \(45\) miles apart. Alicia lives in \(A\) and Beth lives in \(B.\) Alicia bikes towards \(B\) at \(18\) miles per hour. Leaving at the same time, Beth bikes toward \(A\) at \(12\) miles per hour. How many miles from City \(A\) will they be when they meet?

solutions.text: They ride toward each other, so their speeds add. That closes the \(45\)-mile gap at \(18 + 12 = 30\) mph, and they meet after \(\frac{45}{30} = 1.5\) hours. Alice starts at \(A,\) so by then she’s gone \(18 \cdot 1.5 = 27\) miles. Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: They ride toward each other, so their speeds add; find the time until they meet
The meeting time is \(\frac{45}{18 + 12}\) hours; multiply Alice’s speed by that time
